issues.reason: Folding the dependent consequence into one strength-0.0 conjunction is exactly what the instruction set does when negation removes a construction's positive entailment — *Perception reports* says a negated report wraps 'the whole bundle (perception atoms, complement atoms, Stimulus link) in one strength-0.0 conjunction' — and the 'denies only the conjunction' weakness is a property of every negated bundle the instruction set prescribes ('Bob didn't cook dinner'), while the reviewer's alternative would leave (Can (sk_win $x)) asserted of every person, which is flatly false.

gaps_confirmed: Negation scoping over an 'enough N to V' degree-consequence construction: the instruction set fixes the positive shape (Degree … quantity sufficient plus the positive action) but never says how the consequence is carried, or whether it flips, when the matrix clause is denied.
new_gaps: The 'enough … to V' pattern emits no atom LINKING the (Degree … sufficient) to the consequence eventuality — the sufficiency-for-winning relation is only ever co-location in a bundle, so under a conjunction denial nothing records what the votes were insufficient FOR.
notes: The strength-0.0 distributing rule over (Member $x person), the per-binding Skolem vote group kept inside the denial, the projected typing of the definite nomination, and the QuantifierPhrase companion all follow the instruction set as written.
